# ColorSwatchBar

**Class:** `UltraCanvasColorSwatchBar` · **Group:** [Pickers, dialogs and feedback](../Groups/Pickers-dialogs-and-feedback.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasColorSwatchBar.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasColorSwatchBar.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasColorSwatchBar.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A colour out of a small palette (a strip of swatches, sized to the space it gets)

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasColorSwatchBar](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasColorSwatchBar.md)
- [UltraCanvasColorPaletteManager](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasColorPaletteManager.md)
- [UltraCanvasMediaViewer](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasMediaViewer.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasColorSwatchBar> CreateColorSwatchBar( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::vector<Color>& colors = UltraCanvasColorSwatchBar::DefaultPalette());
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasColorSwatchBar> CreateBackdropSwatchBar( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);   // A backdrop chooser: the checkerboard entry first, then the default palette.
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasColorSwatchBar(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasColorSwatchBar(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasColorSwatchBar(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onColorSelected` | `std::function<void(const Color&)> onColorSelected` | a colour swatch was clicked |
| `onColorAdjustSelected` | `std::function<void(const Color&)> onColorAdjustSelected` | A colour swatch was clicked with the right (Adjust) button — the background / secondary colour in a foreground+background picker. It does not move the selection, which tracks left clicks. Unset, right clicks are ignored. |
| `onCheckeredSelected` | `std::function<void()> onCheckeredSelected` | _Checkered selected_ |
| `onAutoSelected` | `std::function<void()> onAutoSelected` | _Auto selected_ |
| `onColorContextClicked` | `std::function<void(int index, const Point2Di& windowPos)> onColorContextClicked` | A colour swatch was clicked with the right button: the entry's index and the click in window coordinates, for a host that edits the entry in a popup there. When set it takes the right click instead of onColorAdjustSelected. |
| `onColorHovered` | `std::function<void(int index)> onColorHovered` | The pointer came onto a colour swatch (its index into GetColors()), or left the bar (-1). Crossing the gap between two swatches reports nothing, so a host previewing the colour does not flicker. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

| `SetColorAt` | `void SetColorAt(int index, const Color& c)` | Replaces one entry in place (an edited palette colour); the selection stays on that entry. An index outside the palette is ignored. |
| `SetShowCheckeredEntry` | `void SetShowCheckeredEntry(bool show)` | A leading swatch showing the transparency checkerboard rather than a colour. It selects like any other swatch but reports through onCheckeredSelected, so a host can switch to "no backdrop colour". |
| `SetShowAutoEntry` | `void SetShowAutoEntry(bool show)` | A swatch before all others, drawn half light and half dark, standing for "choose a colour that suits what is shown". It selects like any other swatch and reports through onAutoSelected; which colour that is is the host's business. |
| `SetWrap` | `void SetWrap(bool wrap)` | Off (the default): one row, the swatches shrinking to fit and centred. On: as many lines as needed to keep every swatch at least minSwatchSize, with the colours shared out evenly over the lines, left-aligned from the top-left corner. Where a line count up to two more than the fewest divides the colours exactly, that … |
